acceptance_criteria: CLI daemon-backed tests fail if unsupported capabilities stop surfacing clearly or if incremental edits retain stale defs in visible results.
description: Cover daemon-backed capability rejection, stale-def disappearance after source edits, and other supported-path semantics that are currently only protected in-process.

notes.author: darin@book
notes.content: Audit: verified in /Users/darin/Projects/raql on jj change 254d74edbbbe. Added supported-path coverage for daemon-backed unsupported capability rejection and warm-session incremental def refresh, plus stronger WorkspaceService proof that rewritten defs disappear instead of lingering stale. Verification: cargo test -p raql-host-ra && cargo test --test cli_daemon_cutover -- --nocapture && cargo test --test cli_strict_runtime -- --nocapture.

title: Add supported-path CLI coverage for capability failures and incremental invalidation
